item.title: Happy Diwali
item.description:
A Few Problems for the Break#

First things first: enjoy your Diwali break! Spend time with your family, meet your friends, eat well, sleep in, and generally do things that have nothing to do with programming.

That said, a few of you asked for something to work on during the break. So here it is: a collection of problems I’ve been thinking about.

These aren’t assignments. There’s nothing to submit, no deadline to worry about, and certainly no expectation that you solve all of them.
